text:
So much to do!

Books not read, letters not written,

Languages not learned,

The love not given,

Everything forgotten.


Friends between farewell,

Children crying in the storm,

Citizens signing papers, papers, papers...

To the end of the world signing papers.


And the birds behind bars of rain.

And the dead in a jar of camphor.


(And a song so beautiful!)


So much to do!

And we only did it.

And we never knew who we were,

Nor for what.

translation.title: Humility
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the poem's inventory of unfinished life, bureaucracy, and the odd final confession of not knowing who or why.
